blurb: Art Space on the Coast is a community art studio in Pacifica, CA. Pacifican and local ceramic artist Jennifer Christiansen is creating a home for the growing population of local artisans and makers looking to share their creative passions with one another and the public. Our collective goal is to provide a space for aspiring artisans while both giving back to the local economy and creating a new sense of community.
